label: early original-phase input of p/1/k/3/b
explanation: Fires mostly in the original phase (82% of mass) when the input is one of p, 1, k, 3, b (lift 3.4-5.5x; p and 1 strongest), and much more often in the first three positions (t=0..2 hold about 70% of mass; rate falls off steeply after t=3). Restricting to t<=1 gives precision 0.87 but recall 0.44. A second, weaker component is the <DEL> step (14% of mass). It holds the very top activations, in short sequences (L=3-4) that start with a/o/n/l, but this part has no clean predicate (precision 0.33 at best). Later occurrences of the same tokens also fire weakly, and repeats right after an earlier one (e.g. p p, 1 1) can fire strongly. Nearly silent in the copy phase (rate 0.9%) and on most other letters (h, j, u, d near zero). Dev: P=0.71, R=0.55, F1=0.62, mass recall 0.63.
